user.title: Set up HA Whisker Pet ID
user.description: Connects to your existing Whisker (litterrobot) integration to expose Litter-Robot 5 Pet ID visits, camera clips, visit reassignment actions, AI health summaries, and AI Vision Auto-Pet-ID verification.

data.robot: Litter-Robot 5 unit (leave empty if only one unit)
data.ai_task_entity: AI Task entity (optional, any AI provider)

error.no_litterrobot_lr5: No loaded Whisker integration with a Litter-Robot 5 was found. Configure and load the official Whisker integration first.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

init.title: Configure AI Health Summaries & Auto Pet ID
init.description: Configure your Litter-Robot target, Home Assistant AI Task entity, notification target, cat scale weight bounds, snapshot camera, and Auto-Pet-ID guardrails.

data.robot: Litter-Robot 5 unit (leave empty to auto-select sole unit)
data.snapshot_camera_entity: Troubleshooting snapshot camera entity (optional room camera)
data.snapshot_max_files: Snapshot history limit (max local JPEG files)
data.auto_pet_id_mode: Auto Pet ID verification mode (off, dry_run, auto_reassign)
data.enable_hybrid_fast_path: Enable 0-token hybrid weight fast-path for unambiguous cats
data.video_escalation: AI clip inspection mode (thumbnail_only or thumbnail_then_video)
data.auto_unassign_scale_glitches: Automatically unassign scale anomalies below min weight
data.auto_pet_id_notify: Push notification policy for Auto Pet ID (uncertain_only, all_actions, none)
data.auto_pet_id_max_per_run: Max flagged visits evaluated per automatic cycle
data.auto_pet_id_clip_delay_seconds: Seconds to wait for LR5 clip upload before inspecting
data.enable_push_alerts: Send push notifications for daily summaries and cluster alerts
data.cluster_min_visits: Minimum visits to flag a repeat-visit cluster
data.alert_cooldown_hours: Minimum hours between repeat cluster alerts per cat

error.invalid_weight_bounds: Minimum valid cat weight must be strictly less than maximum valid cat weight.

get_pets.name: Get Whisker Pets
get_pets.description: List all Whisker pet profiles with baseline weights, tags, and recent weight history.

refresh.name: Refresh from Cloud
refresh.description: Force a fresh GraphQL fetch of pet profiles and weight histories before returning.

list_visits.name: List LR5 Visits
list_visits.description: Fetch recent Litter-Robot 5 activities, join matching Pet ID camera clips, and flag misattributions.

robot.name: Robot
robot.description: Optional Litter-Robot 5 name or serial (defaults to configured or sole LR5 unit).

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of activity records to retrieve.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Number of activity records to skip for pagination.

activity_type.name: Activity Type
activity_type.description: Filter activity type (e.g. PET_VISIT, or empty string for all events).

date.name: Date
date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD local date filter for clips and visits.

include_clips.name: Include Camera Clips
include_clips.description: Join matching LR5 camera clips by event ID or timestamp proximity.

max_clip_delta_seconds.name: Max Clip Delta Seconds
max_clip_delta_seconds.description: Maximum seconds between a visit timestamp and a camera clip timestamp to treat as a match.

get_clip_urls.name: Get LR5 Clip URLs
get_clip_urls.description: Exchange a recorded LR5 clip ID for short-lived presigned S3 MP4 chunk URLs and HLS cookies.

clip_id.name: Clip ID
clip_id.description: The recorded camera clip ID from list_visits.

reassign_visit.name: Reassign LR5 Pet Visit
reassign_visit.description: Reassign, assign, or unassign a Litter-Robot 5 PET_VISIT event via Whisker's REST API.

event_id.name: Event ID
event_id.description: The eventId of the PET_VISIT activity to modify.

from_pet.name: From Pet
from_pet.description: Name or petId currently assigned to the visit (provide alone to unassign, or with to_pet to reassign).

to_pet.name: To Pet
to_pet.description: Name or petId to assign the visit to (omit to unassign).

refresh.name: Refresh Sensors
refresh.description: Refresh Home Assistant's Litter-Robot and Pet ID coordinators after updating.

generate_health_summary.name: Generate AI Pet Health Summary
generate_health_summary.description: Generate household and per-cat Litter-Robot 5 health summaries using a configured Home Assistant AI Task with automatic deterministic fallback.

hours.name: Lookback Window (Hours)
hours.description: Number of hours of PET_VISIT telemetry to analyze (defaults to configured option).

ai_task_entity.name: AI Task Entity
ai_task_entity.description: Optional ai_task entity ID override (defaults to configured option, e.g. ai_task.my_ai_task).

use_ai.name: Use AI Task
use_ai.description: Use configured AI Task when available; if false, compute deterministic summary only.

notify.name: Send Push Notification
notify.description: Send the generated summary/alert to the configured or overridden notify service.

notify_service.name: Notify Service Override
notify_service.description: Optional notify service name(s), comma-separated (e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone).

configure_health.name: Configure AI Health & Auto Pet ID Options
configure_health.description: Persist HA Whisker Pet ID robot selection, health summary schedule, AI Task entity, notify target, weight bounds, and Auto-Pet-ID options.

robot.name: Litter-Robot Unit
robot.description: Optional Litter-Robot 5 name or serial (leave empty to auto-select sole unit).

ai_task_entity.name: AI Task Entity
ai_task_entity.description: Home Assistant ai_task entity ID (e.g. ai_task.my_ai_task).

notify_service.name: Notify Service Target
notify_service.description: Home Assistant notify service name(s), comma-separated (e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone).

min_valid_weight_lbs.name: Minimum Valid Cat Weight (lb)
min_valid_weight_lbs.description: Readings below this weight are treated as scale anomalies or partial entries.

max_valid_weight_lbs.name: Maximum Valid Cat Weight (lb)
max_valid_weight_lbs.description: Readings at or above this weight are treated as scale anomalies or multi-cat entries.

weight_mismatch_lbs.name: Weight Mismatch Threshold (lb)
weight_mismatch_lbs.description: Difference from a cat's baseline weight before flagging a visit as a mismatch.

enable_daily_summary.name: Enable Daily Summary
enable_daily_summary.description: Enable or disable the scheduled daily health summary.

summary_hour.name: Daily Summary Hour
summary_hour.description: Local hour (0-23) to run the daily health summary.

summary_minute.name: Daily Summary Minute
summary_minute.description: Local minute (0-59) to run the daily health summary.

enable_push_alerts.name: Enable Push Alerts
enable_push_alerts.description: Enable or disable push notifications on daily summaries and repeat-visit clusters.

health_window_hours.name: Lookback Window (Hours)
health_window_hours.description: Number of hours of PET_VISIT telemetry to analyze.

cluster_window_minutes.name: Cluster Window (Minutes)
cluster_window_minutes.description: Sliding window in minutes for detecting repeat visits.

cluster_min_visits.name: Cluster Minimum Visits
cluster_min_visits.description: Minimum number of visits inside the window to flag a repeat-visit cluster.

alert_cooldown_hours.name: Alert Cooldown (Hours)
alert_cooldown_hours.description: Minimum hours between repeat cluster notifications per cat.

auto_pet_id_mode.name: Auto Pet ID Mode
auto_pet_id_mode.description: Automatic verification mode for flagged LR5 visits (off, dry_run, or auto_reassign).

enable_hybrid_fast_path.name: Enable Hybrid Fast-Path
enable_hybrid_fast_path.description: Use 0-token weight reassignment when scale weight unambiguously separates one cat from all others.

video_escalation.name: Video Escalation Mode
video_escalation.description: Thumbnail only, or escalate to MP4 video chunks when AI Vision is uncertain.

auto_pet_id_min_confidence.name: Minimum Auto-Reassign Confidence
auto_pet_id_min_confidence.description: Minimum AI confidence required for automatic reassignment (high or medium).

auto_unassign_scale_glitches.name: Auto-Unassign Scale Glitches
auto_unassign_scale_glitches.description: Automatically unassign scale anomalies below Minimum Valid Cat Weight without calling AI Vision.

auto_pet_id_notify.name: Auto Pet ID Notification Policy
auto_pet_id_notify.description: When to push mobile notifications for Auto Pet ID checks (uncertain_only, all_actions, or none).

auto_pet_id_max_per_run.name: Max Flagged Visits Per Run
auto_pet_id_max_per_run.description: Maximum flagged visits processed per automatic cycle.

auto_pet_id_clip_delay_seconds.name: Clip Upload Delay (Seconds)
auto_pet_id_clip_delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait after a visit before checking clips so LR5 camera upload completes.

snapshot_camera_entity.name: Troubleshooting Snapshot Camera
snapshot_camera_entity.description: Optional Home Assistant camera entity to capture an extra room freeze-frame alongside LR5 thumbnails (leave empty to disable).

snapshot_max_files.name: Snapshot History Limit
snapshot_max_files.description: Maximum number of local snapshot JPEGs to keep before pruning oldest files.

verify_visits_with_ai.name: Verify Flagged Visits with AI Vision
verify_visits_with_ai.description: Evaluate recent flagged or specified LR5 visits using Hybrid Fast-Path + AI Vision (ai_task.generate_data) with optional dry-run or live reassignment.

event_id.name: Event ID
event_id.description: Optional specific PET_VISIT eventId to verify (otherwise evaluates recent flagged visits).

dry_run.name: Dry Run
dry_run.description: If true, evaluate and log decisions without mutating Whisker; if omitted, uses configured Auto Pet ID Mode.

limit.name: Max Visits
limit.description: Maximum number of flagged visits to evaluate in this run.

video_escalation.name: Video Escalation Override
video_escalation.description: Override thumbnail_only or thumbnail_then_video for this run.

force.name: Force Re-evaluation
force.description: Re-evaluate even if event_id was already processed or reassigned.

get_alert_history.name: Get Historical Pet Alerts
get_alert_history.description: Query persistent HA Whisker Pet ID historical health clusters, summary watches/alerts, and Pet ID review alerts.

pet.name: Pet Name
pet.description: Filter alerts involving a specific pet (e.g. Luna).

days.name: Lookback Days
days.description: Optional number of days back to include.

source.name: Alert Source
source.description: Filter by alert source (health_cluster, health_summary, or pet_id_review).

limit.name: Max Results
limit.description: Maximum number of alert records to return.
